response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile staff-level software engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure work, but his resume shows only a brief, recent (since April 2025) and vaguely described exposure to MCP and agentic workflow tooling. He lacks demonstrated experience with Python, cloud-native AI system design, vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI, all of which are core requirements for this GenAI-focused role.
strengths: 15+ years of senior/staff-level software engineering experience across diverse domains
Recent hands-on work with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow infrastructure
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and driving engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, workshops)
concerns: No evidence of Python experience, a required language for this role
No demonstrated experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI)
Minimal cloud platform experience (only AWS CDK mentioned briefly for infrastructure-as-code, not AI systems)

key_factors.factor: Lack of RAG/vector DB/multi-agent framework experience
Recent MCP/agentic workflow exposure at re:cinq
